from collections import Counter
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
D2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
H,W=len(D2),len(D2[0]); cnt=Counter(v for r in D2 for v in r)
frame=[k for k,v in cnt.most_common()][:2]; frame,col=lineColor=(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0],cnt.most_common(2)[1][0])
print(frame,col,lineColor)
# line rows/cols: rows/cols that are ~all lineColor
Lr=[r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for c in range(W) if D2[r][c]==lineColor)>=W*0.8]
Lc=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if D2[r][c]==lineColor)>=H*0.8]
print(Lr,Lc)
out=[]
for i in range(len(Lr)-1):
    row=[]
    for j in range(len(Lc)-1):
        blk=[D2[x][y] for x in range(Lr[i]+1,Lr[i+1]) for y in range(Lc[j]+1,Lc[j+1])]
        cc=Counter(blk)
        an={k:v for k,v in cc.items() if k not in (frame,col)}
        m=max(an,key=an.get) if an else None
        row.append(m if m is not None and m!=lineColor else col)
    out.append(row)
print(out==O2,out,O2)

        A=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; B=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']

        Lr=[r for r in range(H) if len({v for v in A[r]})==2 and fill in A[r] and sum(1 for v in A[r] if v==fill)>W*0.3 and any(v!=fill for v in A[r])]
        Lc=[c for c in range(W) if len({A[r][c] for r in range(H)})==2 and fill in {A[r][c] for r in range(H)} and sum(1 for r in range(H) if A[r][c]==fill)>H*0.3 and any(A[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]

        res=[[nonbg[0] if len(cs)==1 and next(iter(cs))!=fill else fill for j,_ in [(j,c) for j in range(len(Lc)-1)] for c in [None]][0]]

import collections
def solve(G):
    res={}
    for p in ('1','2','3'):
        A=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; B=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
        H,W=len(A),len(A[0]); cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in A for v in r)
        fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        # lines dominate by the SECOND-most-common color (global line color)
        c2=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
        Lr=[r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for c in range(W) if A[r][c]==c2)>=W*0.8]
        Lc=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if A[r][c]==c2)>=H*0.8]
        print(p,'fill',fill,'c2',c2,'Lr',Lr,'Lc',Lc)
        out=[]
        for i in range(len(Lr)-1):
            row=[]
            for j in range(len(Lc)-1):
                vals={A[Lr[k]][Lc[j+1]] for k in (i,i+1)}
                C=[x for x in vals if x!=fill][0] if len(vals)==1 and next(iter(vals))!=fill else None
                row.append(C if C is not None else fill)
            out.append(row)
        print(' out ',out,'\n B  ',B,'\n')
solve(G)

def f_int(G):
    H,W=len(G),len(G[0])

        row=[]
        for j in range(len(Lc)-1):
            vals=[G[r][cc] for r in range(Lr[i]+1,Lr[i+1]) for cc in range(Lc[j]+1,Lc[j+1])]

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter

def solve(A, thr=None):
    h,w=len(A),len(A[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in A for v in r)
    f=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; l=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    marks=[[1 if A[r][c] not in (f,l) else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    rlist=[r for r in range(h) if any(marks[r])];clist=[c for c in range(w) if any(marks[r][c] for r in range(h))]
    def gaps(idx):
        return [(a,b) for a,b in zip(idx,idx[1:])]
    rg=gaps(rlist) if len(rlist)>1 else []
    cg=gaps(clist) if len(clist)>1 else []
    out=[]
    for ra,rb in rg:
        row=[]
        for ca,cb in cg:
            vals={(ra,ca),(ra,cb),(rb,ca),(rb,cb)}
            cs=set(A[r][c] for r,c in vals)
            c=f
            if len(cs)==1 and cs!={(ra,ca)[0]} or True: pass
            cand=list(cs)-{f}
            if len(cand)==1:
                v=cand[0]
                if all(A[r][c]==v for r,c in vals): c=v
            row.append(c)
        out.append(row)
    return out

for p in ('1','2','3'):
    A=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; B=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    o=solve(A)
    print(p, o==B, o, B)
